verdict.rationale: The evidence shows vLLM as an inference engine exposing OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic APIs, CLI tooling, and a FastAPI Swagger/ReDoc API explorer. None of these is a built-in graphical chat interface. The Swagger UI is an adjacent API-documentation feature, not a chat GUI, and community users rely on external ChatGPT-style apps through the API.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can chat with local models using a built-in graphical chat interface
